# ADR-3234: AWS secrets: Secrets Manager rotation required key for secret 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Static secrets eventually leak.

## Decision

Secret definitions SHALL include a Secrets Manager rotation required key for secret 2 (AWS-secrets-2).

## Consequences

Rotation Lambda ownership is assigned.
